transcript.text: Okay, let's get started, Gwen and Zoe said they'd be a few minutes late. Diego, do you want to kick off with a round of updates from the mech side?

transcript.text: yep

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Thank you, Zoe. Let me go through the open POs. Most are on track. The bearings from last month arrived and passed incoming inspection.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: i can confirm, jade logged them yesterday 🙏
